from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] == 4)
    top, bottom = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom):
        raise ValueError('regions must have equal heights')
    top_bg = Counter(x for row in top for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bottom_bg = Counter(x for row in bottom for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # A mark is retained where a non-background top pixel aligns with a
    # foreground pixel in the lower pattern; recolor the field and marks.
    return [[3 if top[r][c] != top_bg and bottom[r][c] != bottom_bg else 5
             for c in range(len(top[r]))] for r in range(len(top))]

    # The one-color line is the panel divider.

        if len(a) != len(b):
            raise ValueError('unequal panel heights')
        common = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        if len(common) != 1:
            raise ValueError('expected one shared panel color')
        color = next(iter(common))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(len(a[r]))] for r in range(len(a))]
    # vertical divider; split at its column and overlay equal-shaped panels
    c = next(j for j, x in enumerate(grid[0]) if x == 7 and all(row[j] == 7 for row in grid))
    a = [row[:c] for row in grid]
    b = [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    if len(common) != 1 or any(len(x) != len(y) for x, y in zip(a,b)):

    color = next(iter(common))
